_doc: Domain experience leads: category -> the person who owns that domain. auto_reassign.py pulls open tasks owned by Jon/unassigned in a category to its lead, but ONLY where confirmed=true. Seed values are DRAFT, derived from revealed expertise (who actually completes work in each category) + role knowledge. Flip confirmed=true (ideally after the named lead confirms their domain = the 'employee input') to let the weekly job reassign that category. Series A and Government are intentionally kept with Jon.

Blk3 Flight.basis: most open ownership; hardware led by Eaton

Revenue.basis: North Star for all non-Jon staff; specific lead needs employee input

BD.basis: completions spread across Neil/Steve/Lizi/Talley; needs owner decision

Series A.basis: CEO North Star, stays with Jon
